summary: First end-to-end testing pass for FarmTycoon. Ran 16 pytest cases against the live FastAPI backend (all passed, including auto-tick after 12 s wait) and exercised every public page via Playwright. Core flows (reset, state, tick, buy/plant/irrigate/fertilize/herbicide/harvest, resource purchase, sell, fulfill, premium pending-integration) all behave correctly. No critical bugs found; UI renders cleanly, sidebar nav works, premium subscribe toast shows pending_integration message in French, no emoji detected, no console pageerrors.

issues: Recharts emits console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — the chart still renders but its ResponsiveContainer parent likely has no explicit min height during initial layout. Cosmetic only, but noisy in DevTools.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts size warning by giving the Cash-flow chart container an explicit min-height (e.g. h-64) or wrapping <ResponsiveContainer> with width/height numerics.

Optional naming consistency with the spec: data-testids on the Premium tier cards are 'tier-monthly/tier-annual' (spec mentioned 'premium-tier-*'); Market spot rows use 'market-row-{key}' (spec mentioned 'market-crop-*'); Crops parcel cards use 'crop-card-{id}' (spec mentioned 'crops-parcel-*'); Resources buy buttons use 'buy-{key}' / 'inc-{key}' / 'dec-{key}' (spec mentioned 'buy-resource-*' / 'resource-plus-*' / 'resource-minus-*'). All elements DO exist and are reachable — just consider aligning names if external tests assume the spec naming.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _auto_tick caps to 30 in-game days per call which is sensible. Good.
Mongo _id is properly stripped in every read ({'_id': 0} projection). Verified absent from /api/game/state response.
game_logic.generate_contracts seeds and then resets the RNG (random.seed() at the end) — good practice, prevents leaking determinism to other calls.
Frontend chart container should have explicit min-height to avoid the width/height(-1) Recharts warnings.
GameContext polls every 6 s — that is fine but every poll triggers a Mongo read+write (auto-tick). Under load consider caching when ticks_applied == 0 to avoid the replace_one churn.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/game/reset called at start of pytest session (fresh global state)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is single global save at GAME_ID='global' in Mongo. Always POST /api/game/reset before assertions that depend on starting cash/day. Auto-tick = 1 game day per 10 real seconds; force-tick endpoint exists. Frontend polls every 6 s. Real data-testid prefixes differ slightly from the original spec — see action_items for the mapping. Frontend external URL: https://agri-management-3.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: No bugs detected; nothing to root-cause.
